# Marrow Fieldworks renewal call

**Attendees:** Me, Hollis Mbeki (dropped after 10 mins), Ned Vance & Carla Yates (MFW ops), June Osei-Lark (joined at the end for sigs)

### Notes
* Finally got this across the line! Signed today right on the call while June was watching the DocuSign envelope, thank god. 
* Spent the first fifteen mins talking about spring planting backups at their Salina dealership yard—apparently two flatbed drivers hauling combine headers got stuck at Gate 3 on Tuesday bc the kiosk glare made the check-in QR code unreadable. Ned wants to know if Pemberline Dock has a high-contrast mode for the gate tablet app. I said I'd check w/ product.
* Carla mentioned their second-shift yard jockeys at the Kearney depot keep forgetting to close out departed trailers in the Bay 4 & Bay 5 queues, which messes up the Morning Yard Snapshot rpt. Totally a training thing, not a bug, tho Carla swore the button moved (it didnt).
* Hollis hopped on just to say hi to Ned and hear about the tornado watch out by Grand Island yesterday, then had to bounce for another mtg.

### Action Items
* [ ] Me: Send Carla the 2-page PDF cheat sheet for yard jockey check-out flows.
* [ ] Me: Ask eng about kiosk high-contrast / dark mode (ticket #PD-8841 maybe?).
* [ ] June Osei-Lark: pushing the counter-signed paperwork over to Stoneharrow Billing once she grabs lunch.
